description: Production codec base closure: the PRD Common Formats roadmap — MP3, FLAC, AAC/M4A, raw ADTS AAC, ALAC/M4A, PCM WAV (u8/s16le/s24le/s32le/f32le/f64le), Ogg Vorbis, Ogg Opus. This is the canonical import profile (xmake ffmpeg-import) and the codec base the DSP closure derives from; it is the shipping closure inside libsongcore artifacts. Matroska stays out of production (test fixtures only — see songcore-test). SongCore performs the planar->interleaved Float32 conversion itself and never resamples.

lib:swresample.reason: FFmpeg n9.0.1 configure hard dependency of the native Opus decoder (Disabled opus_decoder ... not all dependencies are satisfied: swresample). SongCore does not use swr; no resampler path exists in SongCore's own PCM conversion.
